meta_title: Premier Painter & Decorators | Liverpool Painting Services
meta_description: Premier Painter & Decorators in Liverpool. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration services. Free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. Free quotes, no mess, stunning results every time.
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Redecoration
services.desc: Bedroom, lounge, kitchen, and bathroom repaints using premium finishes. We move furniture, protect floors, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior walls, fascias, soffits, and doors with quality paints built to last. Includes pressure cleaning and surface preparation.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging, pattern matching, and removal of old coverings. From classic designs to modern accent walls.

services.title: Woodwork & Door Finishing
services.desc: Paint doors, skirting boards, architrave, and shutters to a high-gloss or satin finish. Includes sanding and undercoating for flawless coverage.

services.title: Ceiling Artex & Textured Finishes
services.desc: Ceiling repairs, Artex removal or refresh, and application of textured coatings. Creates drama and hides imperfections.

services.title: Commercial & Property Maintenance
services.desc: Redecorating rental properties, shop fronts, and offices on budget. Rapid turnaround and minimal disruption to business operations.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own — attention to detail, no shortcuts.
about_para_1: Premier Painter & Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Liverpool for over 20 years. Founded on the belief that good decoration shouldn't be a luxury, we've built our reputation by delivering flawless finishes on time and on budget. Our team takes pride in every brushstroke, whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a full commercial refit.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we listen. We protect your home, clean up properly, and stand behind our work with a satisfaction guarantee. We're not the cheapest, but we're reliable, friendly, and we get it right first time. That's why 8 in 10 of our new jobs come from word-of-mouth referrals from happy customers.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Fantastic job on our lounge. Mark came out for a free quote and was honest about what we needed. The team turned up on time, covered everything, and the finish is immaculate. Bit of a mess beforehand but they cleaned up properly. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had the whole house redecorated including some tricky textured ceilings. They removed the old wallpaper and made a right good job of it. Fair price, friendly lads, and they sorted out a small crack in the plaster without moaning. Booking them again for the outside next spring.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Our rental needed repainting before new tenants moved in. Premier got it done in 5 days, made the place look brand new. Professional, quick, and tidy. Saved us a fortune and saved hassle. Will use them for our other properties.
reviews.author: Michael T.
